events.summary: Nahiri tells Jace that Zendikar is her world, down to its bones.
events.quote: "This is my world, Jace, down to its very bones."

events.summary: The death of the Eldrazi did not still the Roil.
events.quote: In theory, the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.

events.summary: Jace traced Nahiri to the Singing City, where its magic threatened his mind.
events.quote: Jace traced Nahiri to the Singing City, but the magic of the ancient ruins threatened to overwhelm his mind.

events.summary: An ancient sea monster dragged the Murasa Skyclave under the waves.
events.quote: An ancient sea monster dragged the Murasa Skyclave under the waves, then smaller sea monsters moved in.

events.summary: The bloodchiefs were annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled vampires.
events.quote: With the bloodchiefs annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled, the swamps around Malakir are full of dangerous, young vampires eager to make their marks.

events.summary: Nahiri ignored Nissa's warnings and repeated history by lithoforming.
events.quote: Heedless of Nissa's warnings, Nahiri repeated history.

events.summary: Nahiri declares that it is time for her home to know peace.
events.quote: "Zendikar has suffered enough. It is time, at last, for my home to know peace."

events.summary: The Kargan tribes won a costly victory over the Akoum Skyclave.
events.quote: The Kargan tribes share legends of the victory their ancestors won over the Akoum Skyclave, and its horrendous cost.

events.summary: Drana, the last bloodchief, leads vampires to new strength in unity.
events.quote: Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.

events.summary: The ruins awakened and their defenses with them.
events.quote: When the ruins awakened, so did their defenses.
